hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Read $2x + y$ as "two copies of $x$ and one copy of $y$". With $x = 3$ and $y = 7$, that is $3 + 3 + 7$.
Match each letter to its own value, then think about which operation comes first.
Substituting gives $2(3) + 7$. Multiply $2$ by $3$ before you add the $7$.

explanation: Replace $x$ with $3$ and $y$ with $7$ to get $2(3) + 7$.
Multiply first, because $2x$ means $2$ times $x$, which gives $2 \times 3 = 6$.
Then add the value of $y$ to that product: $6 + 7 = 13$.
The value of the expression is $13$.
